crossRefs.note: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.
Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh, the God of Israel.
For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up…
But to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his…
then it shall happen that to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, there you…

As Yahweh commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil…
You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were…
I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.
Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.
translations.bsb: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
translations.asv: Whither the tribes go up, even the tribes of Jehovah, For an ordinance for Israel, To give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.
